description: An `if` condition's unset-path rule follows evaluation: `has()`, the ternary, `&&`/`||` and `exists` guard the read they actually protect, so a guarded deeper read, an untaken branch, a short-circuited `&&`/`||` side and an already-decided `exists` element all take `then` instead of being forced `false`, while a guard that names the exact path read still works as before.
